aliasing: inputs and returned outputs must not alias unless the definition explicitly permits it
layout_constraints: tensor shapes and declared axis order are preserved

computation.definition: Gated Delta Net prefill with GVA configuration and k-last state layout. The state is in k-last layout [N, H, V, K]. Captured from Qwen3 Next linear attention layers (TP=4).
dependencies: The executable mathematical reference is frozen by reference_sha256.
forbidden_rewrites: Dropping or changing outputs, state transitions, variable-length boundaries, dtypes or declared layouts.
Special-casing input values or workload UUIDs instead of the declared axes and tensor metadata.
legal_rewrites: Any decomposition, fusion, tiling, scheduling or specialization preserving the ABI and numerical acceptance rule.

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Query tensor.
inputs.name: q

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Key tensor.
inputs.name: k

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Value tensor.
inputs.name: v

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Recurrent state in k-last layout [N, H, V, K].; optional ABI argument
inputs.name: state

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Log decay parameter (learnable). Used to compute g = exp(-exp(A_log) * softplus(a + dt_bias)).
inputs.name: A_log

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Input-dependent decay from projection.
inputs.name: a

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Decay bias (learnable). Added to 'a' before softplus.
inputs.name: dt_bias

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Update gate input from projection. beta = sigmoid(b).
inputs.name: b

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Cumulative sequence lengths for variable-length batching.
inputs.name: cu_seqlens

inputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Scale factor. Default is 1/sqrt(head_size).
inputs.name: scale

numerics.acceptance: All outputs: atol=0.01, rtol=0.01, matched element ratio >= 1; NaN/Inf mismatch fails.
numerics.accumulation_dtype: as fixed by the mathematical reference; recurrent state is float32

outputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Attention output. Shape follows num_v_heads in GVA mode.
outputs.name: output

outputs.layout: contiguous in declared axis order; Updated recurrent state in k-last layout [N, H, V, K].
outputs.name: new_state
